claims: NYSE identity/tradability is validated; Q2 operating/backlog claims trace to Centrus issuer reporting and current market context is independently observable.

$3.0B contingent enrichment backlog, $900M DOE HALEU award and expansion activity support strategic demand and bottleneck evidence; Q2 revenue grew while net income declined, and September equity/warrant financing adds funding plus dilution risk.

thesisQuality.basis: Binding/contingent customer backlog and DOE support validate demand, but scale-up remains unfinished.

financialOperatingMomentum.basis: Q2 revenue rose 14% and LEU segment revenue 22%, while net income declined.

marketValuationOpportunity.basis: Current market price context remains volatile and reflects a substantial security premium; dilution tempers upside asymmetry.

catalystScore.basis: DOE award, enrichment expansion and first new centrifuge targeted by year-end provide identifiable catalysts.

governancePower.basis: Execution/disclosure are adequate, but large capital expansion and recent financing prevent a stronger stewardship inference.

alignment2036.basis: Domestic HALEU/enrichment is a strategic nuclear-fuel capability with national-security relevance.

crossDivisionLeverage.basis: LEU and HALEU demand channels diversify enrichment exposure but remain within one nuclear-fuel platform.

bottleneckControl.basis: Domestic HALEU enrichment capacity is scarce and DOE-backed expansion targets a real strategic constraint.

scenarioRobustness.basis: Backlog and federal support provide resilience, offset by policy and buildout dependence.

substitutionResilience.basis: Qualified enrichment capability has high barriers, though foreign enrichment remains a substitute.

supplyChainResilience.basis: Domestic expansion improves resilience but construction/capacity dependencies remain material.

pricingPower.basis: Scarce enrichment capability and multi-year customer demand support value capture, with realized scaled margins still unproven.

riskEvidence.basis: Capacity buildout, policy dependence, delivery timing and equity/warrant dilution remain material.

dataConfidenceEvidence.basis: Fresh primary Q2 evidence covers operations/backlog and current independent market context exists; scaled economics remain partly unknown.

scoreRecord.thesis: Centrus controls a scarce domestic enrichment capability positioned for nuclear and national-security demand, with backlog and federal support validating expansion.
scoreRecord.keyRisk: Commercial-scale execution and financing dilution can prevent backlog from becoming durable per-share economics.
scoreRecord.nextCatalyst: Year-end 2026 targeted completion of the first new centrifuge and expansion milestones.
